recommendation: 1. Book departures before 10 a.m. (7-10 a.m. default) for time-critical trips
evidence: 96 -> 52 per 1,000 trips an hour late or stranded (46% fewer); delay hours 460 -> 270
trade-off: Earlier wake-up; fewer flight options; 7-10 a.m. keeps most of the gain
KPI: Share of time-critical bookings before 10 a.m.; severe-disruption rate

recommendation: 2. Nonstop first; if connecting, 90+ min layover via approved hubs
evidence: Nonstop 9% vs one-stop 16% (45-min) / 14% (90-min) an hour late; best hubs ~9% vs worst ~21%
trade-off: Nonstops can cost more (break-even ~$100-200 one-way); longer layovers add ~1 h
KPI: Share of trips nonstop; missed-connection rate; overnight strandings

evidence: On the 43% of trips with a choice: 98 -> 84 per 1,000 (15% fewer)
trade-off: May conflict with loyalty programmes or negotiated fares; review quarterly
KPI: Compliance with preferred list; severe rate on covered routes

recommendation: 4. Season & weather rule: day-before travel or extra buffer in summer/winter; forecast-triggered rebooking
evidence: Summer evening p95 delay 3.4 h vs morning 1.1 h; adverse-weather days 33% vs 18% disrupted
trade-off: Hotel nights for day-before travel; travel desk effort
KPI: Meetings missed; rebookings triggered; hotel spend

recommendation: Supporting: Tue/Wed where flexible; avoid last flight of the day; trigger-based care
evidence: Tue/Wed 80 vs 96 per 1,000; last flight 3.9x overnight stranding
